descriptions.notStarted: Now that you know what's written in the letter… what should you do? You'd better go to #b#m140000000##k and talk to #b#p1201000##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1201000# says that it's essential to warn #m130000000# about the Seal Stone and writes a letter urging them to protect it at all cost. Your job is to go to #b#m130000000##k and hand the letter to the Queen, but with that annoying strategist of the Queen, Neinheart, blocking the way, it might be difficult. Maybe you should just talk to the #bStrategist#k instead.
descriptions.completed: You met the Queen's strategist, #p1101002#. He took the letter and told you he'd take it into consideration, but his eyes tell you otherwise.
